title.en: Exempting Coconut Oil From the Coconut Levy and Sales Tax as Well as From the Special Fund Impost to Diesel
title.orig: Exempting Coconut Oil From the Coconut Levy and Sales Tax as Well as From the Special Fund Impost to Diesel

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation
source.url: LawPhil (source has HTML full text only)

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 EO_00827_1982_html.txt

text.en:
Coconut oil to be used as engine fuel, either in its pure state or as blending component for diesel fuel,
be exempted from the coconut levy and sale tax, and the special fund impost and specific tax normally applied
to diesel fuel.

The Ministry of Energy shall, in consultation with the Ministers of Finance and the NEDA and upon
recommendation of the Commissioner of Internal Revenue, promulgate the appropriate rules and regulations
to implement this Order.

The Philippine Coconut Authority and the Board of Energy shall, likewise in consolation with the
Ministers of Energy and the NEDA, promulgate such rules and regulations as may be necessary to implement

This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the city of Manila, this 1st day of September, in year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-two.
